text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess appears exhausted, so I take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I suppose even Princess Fighter does always tell the viewers to "train hard, eat well, and get plenty of rest!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-where am I?!

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text: It's nice to make your acquaintance, Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What?! P-Princess Fighter?! I-i-i-in the flesh?!

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's not just me! Take a look over there.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wow! It's the Princess Fighter☆Stars and the Princess Fighter♪Quartet! The heroines from across the generations are all gathered here!

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right! And we're all about to race together! As for you, Kawakami Princess…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you inviting me to join your race?!

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text: Of course! Hehe, are you prepared?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You… you bet! I'm ready and raring to go anytime!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: If I'm with all of you, I could run to the ends of the universe!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Huh?! A dream? Awww, and we were just about to reach Andromeda, too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But still! I got to run a bunch with everyone from Princess Fighter! It was exhilarating!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess returns from the infirmary looking energetic and refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text: We've prepared you a very special seat! You can enjoy watching us run to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, um, right! Th-thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, I'd expect nothing less from the first-generation Princess Fighter! She really knows how to close the gap!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I'm actually seeing this! As a fan, I can barely even put this feeling into… words…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaagh! But still, I really wanted to be out there running alongside them all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urgh, what was I dreaming about just now? All I remember is feeling… disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess returns from the infirmary, but it doesn't look like she's recovered very much.
